fact: COBAC held a consultation on 22-23 June 2026 in Libreville on a revised CEMAC payment services regulation and a draft COBAC regulation on licensing, authorisation and status changes of payment service providers.
title: GABON : Six projets de Règlements bancaires (mise à l'index, liquidité des EMF, Fintechs de paiement, services minimum) soumis à l'examen des professionnels
